author: XtraMajestical
body:
Application
Age: 16
Timezone: GMT 00:00
Do you have access to TeamSpeak? Yes 
Do you have access to Skype? Yes
Do you have access to a recording software? Yes

CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION

Do you have any experience as a staff member on any servers? I currently as of now have no official experience on a popular minecraft server. The only experience i have had is owning scrim servers and running the server myself controlling players and peoples ranks in order for the server to run efficiently. I have "Helper" rank on Kojas SMP server which attracted a fair amount of players but didn't have many staff permissions. I had staff during the "Beaty and the Gamemodes" un official tournament and i mainly played as a ref. This meant i could respond to reports according and help the tournament run well. The outcome was that lots of reports came in claiming a player of using auto clicker, i was sent to investigate and recorded the player and the player got banned and the team was disqualified from the tournament. -http://challonge.com/es/BatG

What is your biggest weakness and how do you believe it will affect your moderating? What is your biggest strength and how would this affect your moderating? My biggest weakness would be having to leave a scrimmage in order to take reports. This would be an easy thing to fix as i can easily ask a player to temp sub in for me, or in the worst case just leave the match for a sort time to deal with the report. My biggest strength would be my actively. This is because this is the main server i play on and enjoy, knowing alot of the community. This will mean that my moderating can be at a high standard as ill be on most of the time.


How do you believe you can help improve the Staff Team? I can help out the staff team with important decisions which require an honest and logical, mature answer, which can help the overall decision to look and be better. I can also help by being active during EU times so the staff team doesn't get criticised for un activity, which also results in the server running smother due to players cheating or breaking rules can be punished and this can stop players logging off due to people breaking rules.

What qualities does a leader need to have in your opinion? Do you consider yourself to be a leader? Why? To be a leader you need to be mature and not be threatened by anyone else's opinion, staying by your decision or opinion. Making this decision which can benefit everyone and not necessarily just your self. You need to be able to cope with any small problems or big problems efficiently and correctly. Id consider my self a leader as i believe these qualities best describe myself and i have been a leader of a team on the server so i know what it can be like when making decisions and how to make sure they benefit everyone.

What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator? I am active during EU timings which means i can moderate at times when other staff which are currently staff may find difficult. I also have experiences of a range of clients which can make it easy for me to find out if someone is "Hacking". I am honest and will try my best to help someone fix the problem someone may have and put 100% in to finding someone an answer which they are allowed.

What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills? To be able to interact with the community you need to be able to judge people without a prejudice view point so that you do not make decisions which would be unfair. Also you need to be active and talk calmly without making people fell abit un-comfortable. I have these skills as i am very considerate towards people and have known people with problems and i do a good job at helping people sort out there problems, offering advice.


How much time can you commit to being a staff member (Rough Idea)? Couple hours or more per day all depending on the dates. For example school holidays can be 4^ hours throughout the days. And then school days would be around 2 hours or more/less depending on my plans. Weekends can be around 4 hours aswell depending on plans


CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS

You are currently undergoing your junior moderator trial. A ban evader is online and he is constantly ban evading and hacking. You are the only one online and the only one who is able to be online. What would you do? I would report the matter in mod discord and await a respond. I would request an ip check to ensure the player is ban evading also collecting evidence (recording). I Would freeze the player until someone can attend to assist me and punish the player showing the staff member the evidence.


Another staff member is constantly joining and harassing other people on Teamspeak in their team channel. The staff member is also referee and has physical permissions to be in that channel. However the leaders do not want this staff member in there and they have asked him to leave multiple times. What would you do? Ask the leader how serious they want to take it. I would inform the leader of refs or an official to warn the player, and then result to temp banning the player from ts for abusing permissions.

A player appeals a punishment you gave them. You realise that the evidence file is corrupted and therefore there is no physical evidence. You know however this person did indeed break the rules, what would you do? I would reduce there sentence of the ban to a smaller temp ban as a way or demonstrating that there is no evidence and that im sorry for not having sufficient evidence.

You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confident but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do? I would remind the player which is leaking information which is not allowed and that they need to remove it immediately. I would report the incident to a Senior Mod and show them evidence of them doing it.

One day the Senior Staff team makes a decision you do not agree with. You do not know all the details of the decision or the circumstances in which they were made and you were simply told by another staff member. However you do not like the decision based from what you know. What would you do? Keep my opinion to my self and find out more information about this decision before i start to put forward my views. Then once i know all details i will share my opinion and speak with a staff member about it and let them explain why it was made

CRITERIA 3: OTHER
NOTE: This is a new criteria and these questions are less to do with right/wrong answer and more to do with us getting to know you. Please answer these honestly. There is no right or wrong answer.


What would getting moderator on Avicus mean to you? It would be good as ive always wanted to go behind the scenes and explore the server from a different POV and want to try help the server become bigger by stopping people logging off to hackers or people breaking the rules. Being moderator will also give the chance to help change or improve the server


How passionate are you about Avicus? What does Avicus mean to you? Avicus is what i use to fill any spare time and i enjoy the gamemodes/maps more than any server. Its the server i know best and therefore i like to play it more than any others and if it closed then it would probably result in me to quitting the game all together as i would no longer see a meaning to come online. The server is the server i have known longest and seen develop over time so its always interesting to see whats coming soon.


Do you speak any other languages than English? none as English is my main langauge


Do you have anything else to add to your application? I have always tried to help out on the server by reporting players on discord when breaking the rules so that they are punished, as i like to try make the server run well
Thanks Xtra
